P.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
P.title: Template:Data Lulu/Pix, Faerie Companion
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Pix, Faerie Companion|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lulu
|skill        = I
|icon         = Pix, Faerie Companion.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Lulu}} is assisted by '''Pix''', who follows her around. Whenever '''Lulu''' basic attacks, '''Pix''' fires 3 bolts that deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
|blurb2      = Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers '''Pix''' to them, to which he fires with their basic attacks.
|blurb3      = '''Pix''' snaps back to '''Lulu''' if she moves too far away.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lulu''' is assisted by ''Pix'', an {{tip|untargetable}} faerie, who follows her around and fires a barrage of 3 bolts towards her target whenever she uses a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}}. Each bolt deals {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 39}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it collides with, for a total of {{as|{{pplevel|5*3 to 39*3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} on hitting a single target with all three bolts.
|description2 = Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers ''Pix's'' help to them, causing him to fire the bolts dependent on their basic attacks.
|description3 = ''Pix snaps back to '''Lulu''' if she is too far away.''
|customlabel  = Leash Range
|custominfo   = {{dv|{{tt|1600|Pix' leash range when moving freely}}|{{tt|2050|Pix' leash range when on another unit, estimated}}}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|60|Bolt missile width}}
|speed        = {{tt|900 - 2600|Bolt missile speed, 5200 acceleration; reaching maximum speed within 0.33 seconds}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = proc
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = False
|notes        = 
* ''Pix's'' bolts do not fire alongside abilities that apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects (e.g. {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}).
* ''Pix'' does not fire if the target dies.
* ''Pix'' fires from his own location and not from the unit he is following.
* When on an ally champion, ''Pix's'' damage respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* The empowered attack does not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
** Neither of them will intercept ''Pix's'' bolts.
}}

W.name: Whimsy
W.title: Template:Data Lulu/Whimsy
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Whimsy|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lulu
|skill        = W
|icon         = Whimsy.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lulu}} can cast ''Whimsy'' on herself or the target champion.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Enemy cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends a spell to the target that {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} them into a harmless critter, {{tip|disarm|disarms}} them, and reduces their {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} for a short time.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|Ally cast:}} '''Lulu''' instantly casts a spell on the target that grants {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' can cast ''Whimsy'' on herself or a champion.
|description2 = {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lulu''' launches a spell onto the target enemy champion that {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} them into a harmless critter for a duration, during which their {{as|movement speed}} is reduced by {{as|60|ms}}, and {{tip|disarm|disarms}} them for the same duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 2}} seconds}}
|description3 = {{sbc|Self / Ally Cast:}} '''Lulu''' instantly casts erratic magic upon the target allied champion or herself, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|25%|ms}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
{{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|3 to 4}} seconds}}
|cooldown     = 18
|cast time    = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.2419}}|Enemy cast}}|{{tt|None|Self/ally cast}}}}
|cost         = 65
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 650
|speed        = {{tt|2250|Polymorph travel speed}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies / Allies / Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = True
|callforhelp  = false
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Whimsy's'' {{as|movement speed}} reduction will apply to the target's '''bonus''' movement speed.
** If their '''bonus''' movement speed would be reduced below 0, their '''base''' movement speed is reduced instead equal to the remaining reduction, or by the full amount if the target has no '''bonus''' movement speed.
* ''Whimsy's'' movement speed reduction is not affected by {{tip|slow resist}}.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on {{sti|cooldown}} and pay its cost.{{bug}}
** This only applies to the enemy cast.
}}

E.name: Help, Pix!
E.title: Template:Data Lulu/Help, Pix!
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Help, Pix!|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lulu
|skill        = E
|icon         = Help, Pix!.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lulu}} can cast ''Help, Pix!'' on herself or a unit.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Enemy cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends '''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}''' to the target for a few seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|Ally cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends '''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}''' to the target, {{tip|shield|shielding}} them for a short time if they are a {{tip|champion}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' can cast ''Help, Pix!'' on herself or an ally or enemy.
|description2 = {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the far side of the target enemy for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the same duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|description3 = {{sbc|Self / Ally Cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the target ally for {{fd|6.25}} seconds. If the target is a {{tip|champion}}, they are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
|leveling3    = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|10 to 8}}
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time = none
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 650
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies / Allies / Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = False
|callforhelp  = true
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Help, Pix!'' can be [[Self-targeted|self-cast]].
* If the player casts ''Help, Pix!'' on a non-champion target, the spell script will first search for a targetable allied or enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 75 radius around the target. If there is at least one, it'll apply the effects to the closest one instead of the initial target.
** {{pending for test}} Allies or enemies or proximity take priortity?
** This effect does not respect that the champion may not be visible to '''Lulu''' and not a valid target for normal selection for this reason. Therefore it can for instance apply the effects to stealthed enemy champions this way.{{bug}}
** Since the original cast did not target the champion, some effects (such as {{ri|Guardian}}) may behave incorrectly.{{bug}}
** It is not known in which patch this effect was added.
* {{tip|spell shield|Spell shield}} and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}} will block the damage but '''Pix''' will still follow regardless.
* ''Pix'' will continue to assist the target ally for the full duration even if the shield breaks (the same applies for the shield if the target ally leaves ''Pix's'' leash range).
* ''Pix's'' {{ai|Glitterlance|Lulu}} bolt can be fired while he is away from '''Lulu''' from his location and towards the cursor (effectively extending {{ais|Glitterlance|Lulu}} range).
}}
